label: MOVED_BY_ANOTHER_2: A thing is MOVED_BY_ANOTHER_2 when some thing other than it moves it, in some…
definition: A thing is moved by another when some thing other than it moves it, in some respect (Physics VIII.5, 256a13-21). Lean: `MovedByAnother MovesIn y := ∃ z r, z ≠ y ∧ MovesIn z y r`. 'Moved by something' (ὑπό τινος) is weaker: the something may be the thing itself (DISAMB-MOVED-BY-SOMETHING).
